health.title: Health information sharing authorization
health.body:
This is a separate choice from joining your program. This authorization applies where HIPAA applies and authorization is required. You may authorize or decline. Declining limits only functions that require this authorization.

Information: approved onboarding answers about wellness, stress, sleep, emotional well-being and safety; approved wearable and recovery information; and the concern summary needed for your clinical handoff.

Who may disclose: Pulse Intelligence Labs, AuntEdna, your institution’s authorized health or counseling personnel, and licensed providers involved in your support, for information each lawfully maintains. Recipients: AuntEdna and authorized institutional health or counseling personnel and licensed providers involved in your support. Purpose: approved onboarding transfer, care navigation and clinical-support workflows. AuntEdna clinical notes, diagnoses and treatment records remain in the clinical environment. Coaches receive only information permitted for their role.

Pulse may collect and retain approved program information and transmit designated information. Restricted clinical information must not be used for independent model training, commercial profiling, advertising or unrelated product development. This authorization excludes optional research.

This authorization expires when your program participation ends. You may revoke it in writing through your program’s designated privacy contact or send a request to tre@fitwithpulse.ai for routing to the responsible privacy team. Revocation applies to future uses that rely on this authorization; prior reliance and uses otherwise permitted or required by law are unaffected. Your medical care, benefits, scholarship, team status, playing time and academic standing remain unaffected by your decision. Disclosed information may be redisclosed and may cease to be protected by HIPAA, while other protections may still apply. You can save a copy of your decision and these terms. Tier 2 support also asks for your event-specific choice. Urgent safety events follow the approved institutional protocol and applicable law.

staff.title: Staff confidentiality and responsibilities
staff.body: I will use athlete information only for my assigned team duties and access only the information my role permits. I will protect account access, keep athlete information confidential, and report suspected privacy or security incidents to my program administrator. I will respect each athlete’s participation, health-sharing, and research choices. I will follow my institution’s approved support and emergency procedures and the responsibilities assigned to me. Licensed professionals make clinical decisions. I will never accept an athlete’s personal consent merely because I coach or manage their team. Research use requires the applicable study approval and participant permission.

participation.title: Program participation and privacy
participation.body:
PulseCheck supports performance, wellness reflection, and access to support. AuntEdna supports approved clinical-support and care-navigation workflows. Licensed professionals remain responsible for clinical decisions and care.

Participation is voluntary. You may decline or stop participating without affecting team status, scholarship, playing time, medical care, academic standing, or your relationship with staff. You can choose whether to share optional wellness responses or connect approved wearables. Contact your program administrator to stop participation.

Participation may include onboarding, performance and wellness check-ins, mental training, conversations with Nora, optional wearable information, and feedback. PulseCheck may initially collect and retain approved program information and securely send designated information to AuntEdna for authorized support, care navigation or safety workflows. Access is limited by role and purpose. AuntEdna-generated clinical notes, diagnoses, treatment information and restricted clinical information remain in the clinical environment. Only approved operational status may return to PulseCheck. Clinical or restricted mental-health information sent to AuntEdna must not be available to coaches through the ordinary PulseCheck workflow.

Participant data must not be sold or used for unrelated advertising. Restricted clinical or mental-health information must not be used by PulseCheck for independent model training, commercial profiling or unrelated product development. Approved aggregate or properly de-identified information may support program evaluation and permitted product improvement. Identifiable research use requires its own applicable study consent, authorization or waiver and institutional approval.

AI responses can be inaccurate. Participation may cause emotional discomfort or involve privacy and security risks. Benefits such as greater self-awareness or easier access to support are possible and are not guaranteed. During an emergency, call 911 or call or text 988, or use your institution’s urgent support resources. Platforms are not emergency response services.

A proposed Tier 2 clinical handoff includes a separate choice to accept or decline. Declining that handoff leaves your participation and research choices unchanged. Urgent Tier 3 safety events follow approved institutional procedures and applicable law. Your participation choice does not authorize every disclosure. Health-information authorization, where required, and optional research are separate decisions. You retain your legal rights.

research.title: Optional research choice
research.body:
You may choose whether you are willing to participate in optional research. You can use PulseCheck and participate in the operational program whether you accept or decline.

This choice records willingness only. Before any research activity requiring consent begins, the study team must provide the applicable approved study-specific consent and any required research authorization or documented waiver. Those materials explain the study, information used, recipients, risks, benefits, and withdrawal process. Agreeing here alone does not make your information eligible for a research dataset.
